scope.summary: Implement the penis channel group (spec 13.21; REQ-030 plus the operator oversized-penis requirement, OBR-004): length, girth, curve, taper, glans size, foreskin state continuum, vein intensity (displacement-driven), and scrotum size/tightness as decoupled channels with designed oversized over-range via multi-key tracks (REQ-008/009) - monster-cock territory reachable without extrapolation spikes.
acceptance_criteria: Channels registered with stable ids (penis_length, penis_girth, penis_curve, penis_taper, glans_size, foreskin_state, vein_intensity, scrotum_size, scrotum_tightness), all masked to penis/scrotum regions.

Oversized ranges: length/girth ship with designed over-range through sculpted multi-key stops (e.g. up to the 300% design max per REQ-008/009); oversized extremes pass mesh-quality gates with no linear-extrapolation spikes.
foreskin_state is a continuum (cut through full coverage) that morphs correctly at any glans_size (combination test).
vein_intensity drives a displacement-layer weight (BkSkin MT-566 contract), not a geometry morph, so vein detail scales with the displacement stack.
scope.risk_if_missed: Oversized penis is a named operator production requirement (OBR-004); single-delta scaling instead of multi-key tracks produces exactly the spike/degeneration artifacts REQ-009 documents, and they land precisely in the oversized range the product sells on.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
